test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 500 becomes Rs. 580 at simple interest in 2 years. In how many years will the sum of Rs. 650 amounts to Rs. 858 at the same rate of simple interest?
solution:
Given:

Principle = Rs. 500

Amount = Rs. 580

Time = 2 years

Formula used:

S.I = Amount – P

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Where S.I = Simple Interest

P = Principal, R = Rate, T = time

Calculation:

S.I = 580 – 500 = 80

⇒ 80 = (500 × R × 2)/100

⇒ R = 8%

As per the question,

S.I = 858 – 650 = 208

⇒ 208 = (650 × 8 × T)/100

⇒ T = 4 years.

∴ The time is 4 years.
